name: Ukraine
description: Follow Ukraine, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Russian Strike on Train Station Near Ukraine-Poland Border Seen as Warning to Kyiv’s Allies
changes.summary: The attack on Ukraine’s rail network, which connects the country to the West, was a jab at Europe, officials said.

changes.title: Trump says Ukraine needs to stop targeting Russian refineries
changes.summary: Civilians were killed and injured overnight into Sunday as both Russia and Ukraine kept up large-scale drone strikes.

changes.title: Trump calls on Ukraine to halt strikes on Russian diesel fuel, saying attacks are causing a shortage
changes.summary: Ukraine has for months been targeting Russia's oil and gas industry with long-range strikes, prompting fuel rationing across the country and causing Moscow to ban diesel exports in July, one factor disrupting the global supply of diesel.

changes.title: Train carrying Boris Johnson and ex-CIA chief may have been targeted in Russian strike, officials say
changes.summary: Ukrainian Railways says former British PM and David Petraeus crossed into Poland shortly before drone attack near border A train carrying Boris Johnson and the former CIA chief David Petraeus may have been the target of a Russian drone strike that hit a train engine near the Poland-Ukraine border, according to Ukrainia.

changes.title: Trump Wants Ukraine to Stop Striking Russian Refineries. What Would That Mean for the War?

changes.title: Former Army secretary praises Ukraine in 1st public appearance since resigning
changes.summary: During his 18 months as Army secretary, Dan Driscoll pushed the U.S. military to apply lessons from the war in Ukraine.

changes.title: Trump touts "great conversation" with Putin on ending the war in Ukraine
changes.summary: Russian attacks continue to ravage Ukraine. President Trump says he spoke with President Vladimir Putin about ending the war. Plus, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy's plane was nearly struck by a Russian drone, according to Norway's prime minister. CBS News' Aidan Stretch reports.

changes.title: Zelenskyy visits Canada to seek more military support for Ukraine against Russia
changes.summary: Ukraine is under mounting pressure from Russia's intensifying air campaign that uses ballistic missiles and jet-powered drones to pierce defenses. Moscow's attacks have targeted Ukraine's power grid ahead of winter in what officials say is part of its campaign to demoralize civilians.

changes.title: Q&A: Satellite imagery reveals what casualty figures alone do not tell us
changes.summary: How do we form a picture of conflicts? A new study published in the journal Nature explores how different types of data can be combined to give a fuller understanding of armed conflicts. Lead author Valerie Sticher uses the examples of Ukraine and Myanmar to explain the advantages and limitations of automatically analy.

changes.title: Lithuanian civilians, including children, training for possible Russian attacks
changes.summary: Lithuania is preparing citizens in case the Russia-Ukraine war spreads to their country. CBS News national security analyst Aaron MacLean has the latest.
